mentions.name: Concept
mentions.description: A programming language positioned as a successor to C++, based on the idea of C++20 concepts, featuring templates, comptime, Einstein tensors, async/await, explicit state machines, CPU inference, Vulkan support, easy C interop, and safety proofs built into the language itself. It currently compiles to C11, self-hosting is in progress, and it targets AMD64.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Other is the Concept programming language, as a successor language to C++, based off the idea of C++20 concepts, with templates, comptime, Einstein tensors, async/await, explicit state machines, CPU inference, Vulkan, easy C interop, and safety proofs built into the language itself.
